name: LearnFlow学习流动
description: Choose learning strategies, keep reviewed learning work, and share selected evidence with your course.
description_zh: 选择适合自己的学法，确认保存学习资料；也可以加入课程，把选中的学习过程交给老师。
description_en: Choose learning strategies, save reviewed work, and submit selected evidence to a course for teacher review.
examples_zh: 打开 LearnFlow，看看我选了哪些学习方法
把这次复盘整理成学习块，让我改完再保存
把我选中的练习交给老师，先让我检查提交内容
examples_en: Open LearnFlow and show my selected learning methods.
Draft a learning block so I can edit it before saving.
Prepare selected practice for my teacher and let me review the submission.
